jobs_results.title: Investment Banking Intern (Kochi)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description GHC Growth Lab is a specialized consultancy focused on helping startups transform ideas into viable business models. The firm operates within the startup ecosystem, offering tailored advisory and mentoring services that address the unique challenges of early-stage ventures. Its model is built around a startup for startups approach, leveraging the expertise of experienced professionals to deliver practical guidance. GHC Growth Lab emphasizes quality, prompt support, and qualified execution to help founders build sustainable, scalable businesses.  
Role Description The Investment Banking Intern at GHC Growth Lab will support advisory projects for startup clients through financial analysis, market research, and preparation of pitch materials. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with financial modeling, valuation support, investment memos, and due diligence on potential transactions. The intern will help compile data, prepare presentations, and contribute to strategic recommendations under the guidance of senior team members. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, requiring consistent collaboration with colleagues and startup clients.  
Qualifications  

 Strong Analytical Skills and ability to interpret financial and business data.  
 Foundational knowledge of Finance and Investments, including capital structures and valuation concepts.  
 Hands-on exposure or coursework in Financial Modeling and building basic financial projections.  
 Interest or experience in Due Diligence, including reviewing company information and market data.  
 Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.  
 Proficiency in Excel and presentation tools (e.g., PowerPoint or similar software).  
 Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present findings concisely.  
 High level of curiosity, attention to detail, and willingness to learn in a fast-paced startup environment. .

jobs_results.title: Financial Modelling Consultant (Gurugram)
jobs_results.description:
Consultant - FMS - France Role Title: Consultant Department: Financial Modelling Location: Gurgaon We are recruiting for an Consultant in the team.

Your responsibilities will include

- Support the specification / design of models and analysis tools.
- Develop models (incl. integrated P&L;, Cash flow and Balance sheet models) from scratch.
- Amend models developed by KPMG staff or by third parties.
- Carry out financial analysis of the outputs of models.
- Ensure the consistency in client models and create / maintain project documentation and data books.
- Carry out testing of models as per KPMG quality control procedures.
- Review models and feedback findings to clients using KPMG proprietary software.
- Review and comment on revised models received from clients to verify whether review comments have been acted upon.
- Document the operation of models and the findings from our work.
- Document issues in a business model for inclusion in review reports and liaise with the project manager to fully explain the points raised.
- Design and execute commercial analysis e.g. market sizing, market driver analysis, competitive benchmarking etc.
- Develop business cases and business plans underpinned by robust financial analysis in support of strategic initiatives. To succeed in this demanding role you will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
- 3-6 years working experience of Financial Analysis, Business Modelling or Financial Modelling; • A good working knowledge of accounting, financial statements, and financial analysis; • Solid analytical and problem solving skills; • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel; • A commercial outlook and a good understanding of the general business and economic environment; and • Excellent communication and presentation skills • Ability to build effective networks internally and externally Experience Level Senior Level

jobs_results.title: Financial Modelling Intern - Mumbai
jobs_results.description:
This paid internship position is for a reputed Mumbai based mid-market investment bank.

This is a full-time, hybrid (not remote) position.

An Indian investment bank with technology sector focus is looking to hire a financial modelling intern. In this role, you will be responsible for performing financial analysis and building valuation models for investment banking transactions.

Only candidates who can join immediately and are based in Mumbai should apply.

Students who are currently pursuing any full time or part-time degree/course/professional qualification should NOT apply.

Roles and Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain financial models
• Undertake financial research and analysis
• Work extensively on large, complex excel spreadsheets

Qualifications and Skills:
• Finance graduate/Post-graduate/C.A.
• Deep, hands-on expertise in MS Excel and financial modeling
• Basic proficiency in analyzing financial statements of a company
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills
• Good communication skills, written and verbal
• Attention to detail
• Should be capable of multi-tasking and handling projects with tight deadlines
• Exposure to valuation methodologies would be an added advantage

jobs_results.title: Online Finance Analyst Internship with Startup Exposure
jobs_results.job_title: Online Finance Analyst Internship with Startup Exposure
jobs_results.description:
Step into the startup world with a high-impact Online Finance Analyst Internship. This remote internship offers a unique opportunity to work directly with founders, helping shape the financial backbone of early-stage ventures. You'll be involved in cash flow planning, unit economics analysis, runway forecasting, and market sizing for real startup business models. Unlike traditional finance internships, this role blends financial thinking with entrepreneurial problem-solving—ideal for students or freshers looking to break into venture-backed environments.


Interns will work across tools like Google Sheets, PitchBook data, and basic financial CRMs to assist with monthly reporting, investor updates, and fundraising documentation. You’ll also have exposure to pitch review sessions, startup pitch deck teardown meetings, and internal decision memos.



What makes this internship unique?



Hands-on with early-stage financial strategy, not just theory
Learn how founders and VCs evaluate numbers before making decisions
Regular feedback from startup CFOs, analysts, or ex-founders
Opportunities to work on multiple startup projects across industries
Build a portfolio of live startup case studies and Excel models


If you're excited by the fast-paced startup ecosystem and want to blend finance with innovation, this internship is built for you.
